dmp.description:
The Data Management Plan (DMP) for radiative transfer calculations  at the PMODWRC is developed in the context of effectively managing and preserving valuable data generated for CERTAINTY project. 

The DMP  is designed to maximize the value, accessibility, and impact of the data produced, supporting the Institute's mission in advancing meteorological research and services.
dmp.title: PMODWRC CERTAINTY
